final_objective.what_system_does: SuperEzio Financeiro runs a local financial cockpit where Sentimento Vivo, chart context, Bob, Deep analysis, guardrails, IBKR mirror, trade history, and decision traces operate as one supervised trading surface.
final_objective.who_it_is_for: Marco/F51 as the local operator validating Bob before demo, supervised paper-trading use, and monetization.
final_objective.main_user_flow: Open the cockpit on port 8002, click a Sentimento Vivo ticker such as DIBS, sync ticker/chart, send the prepared TICKER command to Bob, and receive a chart-aware operational reading.
final_objective.start_command: start.ps1 or $env:PYTHONPATH='src'; python -m agent_server.main with CEO llama.cpp already listening on 8082
final_objective.proof_output: DIBS click produces ticker=DIBS, chart_context_ready=true, chart_context containing price 4.09 and 130 candles, and /task/submit routes as ticker_analysis/collect_data.

what_was_done: Fixed the deterministic parser so cockpit-generated commands like 'TICKER DIBS:' cannot be downgraded to industry/general research because of generic words such as 'tese'.
Changed the frontend Bob submit path to wait for the selected ticker chart to load before building the task envelope.
Expanded frontend chart_context with ticker, current price, change percent, last close, last volume, and candle count.
Added stale-context protection so chart_context is not attached if the loaded chart ticker does not match the selected ticker.
Added backend chart-context hard contract text telling Bob not to claim missing price/chart/candles/metrics when chart_context is attached.
Buffered backend CHUNK output for chart-context requests until final validation, then repaired false 'no data/no price/no chart' answers before sending them to the frontend.
Restarted the live backend on port 8002 so the new endpoint code is active.

test_results: Frontend Genie sync contract test passed.
Browser smoke ok=true, AAPL chart candles=130, canvas nonBlank=438400, console_errors=[].

risks: For chart-context requests, Bob response chunks are buffered until validation, so the user sees the answer at once instead of token streaming. This is deliberate to prevent false 'no data' text from flashing in the UI.
The repair answer is deterministic and conservative if Bob still denies attached chart data. The proper path is still ticker_analysis with collect_data, experts, guardrails, and Bob.
NewsAPI is rate-limited with HTTP 429 in the live logs, so news sentiment may be partial until quota resets or provider strategy changes.
IBKR/TWS remains externally dependent and was not changed in this fix.
next_step: Run a full live Bob DIBS answer when Marco wants to spend the model time; the stream route already proves ticker_analysis/collect_data and the browser envelope proves chart_context with DIBS price/candles is attached before Bob sees it.
